abstract: What drove nucleic acids (NA) into functional associations with proteins (PR) at the origins of Life? We reason from polymer physics and the Central Dogma that the fitness value of cooperating through a division of labor - NA for replication fidelity and PR for functional fitness - is much higher than for either polymer alone. Our model shows a Pareto Front, where NA and PR can bootstrap each other to achieve autocatalytic cooperativity towards biology.
